feeds.title: The Full Helping
feeds.description: I'm Gena, voice of The Full Helping, certified nutritionist, cookbook author, and passionate vegan food educator. This space is where I share nourishing plant-based recipes, stories of self-care and self-discovery, and resources to help you explore an informed and compassionate relationship with food.

feeds.title: Cadry's Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cadry. Welcome to my kitchen! This is my vegan food blog, where I share down-to-earth recipes, videos, travel stories, and insights on the vegan lifestyle.

feeds.title: JL Goes Vegan Blog
feeds.description: JL Fields is the founder and culinary director of the Colorado Springs Vegan Cooking Academy. She is a Master Vegan Lifestyle Coach & Educator, Food for Life instructor, chef instructor in the culinary program at the University of New Mexico-Taos.

feeds.title: Sweet Potato Soul
feeds.description: A vegan food and lifestyle blog, cookbook, and cooking show! Featuring easy, delicious, and healthy vegan recipes. Hi, I'm Jenné! On Sweet Potato Soul you'll discover hundreds of delicious and easy-to-make vegan recipes. I also share lots of cooking videos and healthy eating tips.

feeds.title: Luna Bags Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is quite simple we want our customers to feel comfortable, look fashionable - based on their personal choice in style - and feel content that they have made a sustainably responsible purchasing choice. We develop meticulously crafted sustainable and vegan leather bags that are meant for both men and women.

feeds.title: Plantifulheart
feeds.description: Hello everyone, I'm Melanie and I post daily plantbased food inspirations on Instagram. I also have a blog where I post recipes regularly (in german too).

feeds.title: Plant based cards Blog
feeds.description: Plant based blog about all my vegan food creations and my latest cards & gifts. See what vegan recipes I've been making. Subscribe to my plant based food blog for regular updates.

feeds.title: Your Vegan Family Blog
feeds.description: High-performance diets for excellence-driven people who need more energy, focus, stamina, and strength to succeed in their endeavors.

feeds.title: I LOVE VEGAN Blog
feeds.description: I Love Vegan is a vegan lifestyle blog with a focus on delicious, wholesome and homestyle, vegan recipes.

feeds.title: The Minimalist Vegan
feeds.description: We're Michael and Masa! Minimalist Vegan is a resource to bring you delicious vegan recipes using approachable everyday ingredients. We publish recipes, lifestyle articles, cooking videos, and host a podcast to help you live with less stuff and more compassion.

feeds.title: Happy Herbivore Blog
feeds.description: Happy Herbivore is your destination for the plant-based lifestyle!. Lindsay S. Nixon's recipes and cookbooks will save you money by using 'everyday' inexpensive ingredients.

feeds.title: Ethical Elephant
feeds.description: I'm Vicky, the creator of ethical elephant. I'm here to help answer common cruelty-free and vegan lifestyle questions so that you know what, where, and how to shop cruelty-free.

feeds.title: Chic Vegan
feeds.description: Chicvegan.com keeps you at the forefront of ethical and eco-friendly living. We provide all the latest and greatest information on vegan life with interviews of notable vegans, plant-based health information, animal-friendly fashion, cruelty-free beauty, yummy vegan recipes, and other random bits of conscientious information.

feeds.title: Happy Happy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Thinking about trying veganism? Already committed to the vegan lifestyle? Whatever stage you're at, Happy Happy Vegan is for you! Celebrating the vegan lifestyle with all manner of plant-based advice to help you live a meat-free life.

feeds.title: The Glowing Fridge Blog
feeds.description: Shannon is a Certified Hormone Specialist and plant-based blogger living in Chicago. She studied Health and Fitness at Purdue University and loves everything about the plant-based vegan lifestyle, especially creating colourful, nourishing, happy hormone recipes in her kitchen. She helps women heal their bodies from the inside out and balance their hormones naturally through a plant-based diet and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Like a Vegan
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chelsey and welcome to Like A Vegan, a lifestyle blog dedicated to showing you how to eat, look, travel, and live Like Vegan. Established in 2010 as a way to share recipes and tips with friends, Like A Vegan has evolved into a hub for vegans and the vegan-curious around the world, with a fun and light-hearted approach to veganism.

feeds.title: Tedi Sarah
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog full of ideas for plant-based eating, kind living and overall health and wellness. To help readers live healthier, happier lives through plant-based eating, kind living and overall health and wellness.

feeds.title: the chi city vegan
feeds.description: A chicago-based vegan lifestyle blog run by Halley.

feeds.title: Thyme with Tina Blog
feeds.description: My name is Valentina and my healthy lifestyle obsession began a decade ago while I was in high school. For the past few years, I have been spending a lot of my free time experimenting with different foods, gathering healthy recipes, and helping others to improve their diet and eating habits. I have also completed a Nutrition and Weight management course specialised in weight loss management, Childhood nutrition and obesity prevention, and Behaviour change coaching

feeds.title: Mia Ferosh
feeds.description: Mia Ferosh is a luxury, vegan lifestyle blog offering high quality, non-toxic, vegan products from select brands that have cruelty-free, fairtrade and sustainability practises at the heart of their business ethos.

feeds.title: Tea, Cake & Make
feeds.description: Tea, Cake & Make is a Brighton based vegan food and lifestyle blog. It documents the life of a craft-loving, planner addict in her 30s, living in Brighton and Hove in the UK.

feeds.title: All Things Vegan
feeds.description: A UK-based vegan lifestyle blog providing digestible, engaging articles covering fashion, beauty, gifts and All Things Vegan. Articles include quick guides and top 10 product lists.

feeds.title: TerraVeggia
feeds.description: Lifestyle vegan. Vegan cosmetics, vegan shoes, vegan products - vegan life made easy! Here you can find news, events, product tests, competitions...

feeds.title: Vegansaurus
feeds.description: Vegansaurus is a vegan lifestyle guide. It is definitive/arbitrary.

feeds.title: Kelli's Vegan Kitchen
feeds.description: Healthier & Happier Living with a Plant-Based Diet. Kelli's Vegan Kitchen offers programs and classes designed for all your needs. From group cooking classes to team-building sessions, office wellness presentations to home pantry organization, there is something for everyone!

feeds.title: Cook Easy Vegan
feeds.description: Vegan lifestyle and cooking blog with recipes, book, restaurant and product reviews as well as health and cooking resources.

feeds.title: Your Daily Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Your Daily Vegan is a vegan lifestyle blog helping you live a happy, healthy, vegan life. Features recipes, books & movies, and more than 50 vegan guides.

feeds.title: One Arab Vegan
feeds.description: Here, I share with you my ongoing journey towards optimum health, my love for fitness and all things hummus as well as my occasional musings and tips on leading a vegan lifestyle in a culture that doesn't always embrace vegans or vegetarians with arms wide open.

feeds.title: The Kind Life
feeds.description: The Kind Life is a community around Alicia Silverstone and The Kind Diet where friends, doctors, experts in green living, and members share vegan tips.

feeds.title: Vegan Food & Living
feeds.description: Vegan Food & Living is Britain's best-selling vegan magazine dedicated to celebrating all things vegan and cruelty-free. Each issue is packed with 75 recipes, news, in-depth features and more!

feeds.title: Beauty & Colour ❁ Vegan Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Beauty & Colour is the first fashion and lifestyle blog written from a vegan perspective. Based in Los Angeles, the blog features cruelty free beauty and fashion, fitness, and travel inspiration.

feeds.title: Angela Orecchio
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Angela. I've been to over 40 countries on my travels and cleared up health issues like adult acne, anxiety, and depression on a Vegan diet. I'm going to show you how you can live and travel healthy as well.

feeds.title: By Any Greens Necessary by Tracye McQuirter Blog
feeds.description: A vegan trailblazer, author, speaker, public health nutritionist and 30-year vegan, Tracye McQuirter, MPH, is celebrating 25 years of helping people be vegan, healthy, and fabulous.
